assets.packs.description: List the asset packs in every store, the selected pack and where that choice came from. Host side, no Kit, no USD parser. Writes nothing.

assets.pack_doctor.description: Check a pack without changing it: corrupt, missing and unpinned files, then the USD dependencies of its entry files (unresolved, unreadable, remote, outside the pack). Unused files are information. Parses USD in a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; says so if neither ran, and ok is then false.

pack.description: Pack name. Default: the selected pack.

entries.description: Files in the pack that are its roots. Default: recorded in the pack, or the twin's known names for ur5e-dt.

assets.dependencies.description: Compute USD dependency closures with UsdUtils.ComputeAllDependencies for files under an approved root or a user asset store. Uses a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit. Native USD parsing is NOT sandboxed. Copies nothing.

fields.name: paths
fields.description: Absolute USD file paths, 1 to 64.

assets.pack_adopt.description: Create a pack in the primary asset folder, or copy a folder's asset files into it and pin them. The source must be under a user-approved root; no tool can approve folders. A different file already there is refused unless force=true; nothing is written inside the repository.

pack.description: Pack name: one folder name, no path separators.

source_path.description: Absolute folder under an approved root. Omit to create an empty pack.

files.description: Copy only these files or folders, relative to source_path. A named file is copied whatever its type.

entries.description: Root USD files, relative to the pack, for assets__pack_doctor. Default: a sole top-level USD.

dry_run.description: Report the plan and write nothing.

force.description: Replace files that differ from the source.

assets.pack_pin.description: Record the current SHA-256 of a pack's files in its SHA256SUMS, in the primary asset folder. New files are pinned; a pin that would change accepts whatever bytes are there, so it is refused with before and after hashes unless the file is named in files or force=true.

pack.description: Pack name. Default: the selected pack.

files.description: Pin only these relative paths, accepting their changes.

force.description: Accept every changed and removed file.

assets.pack_build.description: Copy USD files and only what they depend on into a pack in the primary asset folder, keeping relative layout, and pin them. Sources must be under an approved root or a user asset store; dependencies outside those are never copied. Follows MaterialX and MDL textures too. Unresolved or remote references refuse the build unless allow_unresolved=true, which records them. Files that differ need force=true. Checks the new pack afterwards.

pack.description: Destination pack name: one folder name.

sources.description: USD files, 1 to 64: absolute paths, or paths inside from_pack. A scene outside from_pack and layout_root is read for its references and not copied.

from_pack.description: Pack that source names and logical references such as robot/ur5e.usd come from.

layout_root.description: Absolute folder the pack layout is relative to. Default: from_pack, or the source's folder.

allow_unresolved.description: Build despite missing or remote references, and record them.

dry_run.description: Report the closure and write nothing.

force.description: Replace files that differ from the source.

assets.import_urdf.description: Convert a trusted approved relative URDF project using the installed importer. Select the shared Physics=physics variant on private generated output when present; refuse missing bodies or expected revolute/prismatic joints before snapshot/import. Returns authored counts, not runtime readiness. No source overwrite. Rejects DTD/entities, package/URL/absolute mesh paths and missing files. Requires 6.x URDFImporter API. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.
